gpu_link: not measured (nvidia-smi -q -d BUS on this driver); the cards are SXM2 on one board
source_tree_note: release source tree (no git metadata on this machine); the engine is built here from that tree with a private CUDA 12.8 toolkit and a private gcc for sm_70 (engine-cuda12/BUILD.json)
engine_launch_command: движок не найден (возможно, запущен не напрямую)
gpus_note: four Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB in one host; the engine runs with --layer-split auto across all four, so every card holds part of the model. nvidia-smi values are per card, index 0..3.

engine_build.note: experimental CUDA 12.8 build for Tesla V100 (sm_70), STRATA_EXPERIMENTAL_SM60=ON; private toolkit and private gcc-14, no system packages installed; updated to 0.1.44.1 on 2026-10-14

toolchain.cuda: private toolkit at /home/dgbox/strata185/cuda-12.8 (nvcc release 12.8, V12.8.93); no system CUDA packages installed
toolchain.note: the release publishes Windows archives only, so both versions are built from source on this machine; the two builds use the same private toolchain

previous_version_swap: the whole source+engine tree is kept side by side (Strata <-> Strata-0.1.43.bak) and swapped by mv; the two server configs were compared and are byte-identical; the model files, the pack, the MTP pack, the control vector and the learned expert profile are outside the trees and are the same files for both versions
agent_observer: this machine also serves the agent that drove the measurements; the agent's own requests go through the same server, so a small amount of agent traffic is unavoidable. It is the same for both versions and for the control run.

host_platform.cpu: 13th Gen Intel Core i9-13900H (Raptor Lake-P), 14 cores / 20 threads, 5400 MHz max, one NUMA node
host_platform.network: 2x Intel X710 10GbE SFP+, 2x Intel I226 (2.5GbE), MediaTek MT7922 Wi-Fi 6 - not in the measured path
host_platform.ram_note: about 16.7 GiB in use with the model loaded, peak 17.5 GiB of the 96 GB installed (under 19%)

gpu_board.board: Spring V100 SXM2 4-GPU, model V100-SXM2-NVLINK_D V2.10
gpu_board.type: SXM2 mezzanine carrier board, NVLink 2.0, Hybrid Cube Mesh; host-side Broadcom PEX8748 PCIe Gen3 switch; 2 external SFF-8654 (Mini-SAS HD) host channels, single x16 or 8+8 bifurcation
gpu_board.cooling: 4 SXM2 modules on a 360 mm AIO liquid loop (the board manual requires it, with a >1500 W PSU)
gpu_board.transition_board: PCIe x16 -> 2 x SFF-8654 (silkscreen PCIE X16-2*X8 SFF 8654); only CH1 is cabled on this machine

host_peg_0000_00_01_0.note: the MS-01 full-length slot is wired electrically as x8

gpu_03_00_0_to_06_00_0.note: four x8 downlinks behind one x8 uplink: the host path is oversubscribed 4:1

pcie_measured.note: read from /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/current_link_width and max_link_width (lspci -vv needs root on this host)

nvlink_measured.topology: nvidia-smi topo -m reports NV2 (two bonded links) between every pair of cards
nvlink_measured.byte_counters: not available: DCGM 4.7.0 on this host has no profiling module (libdcgmmoduleprofiling absent; dcgmi dmon -e 1012,1013 -> 'module not currently loaded'), same for a host engine started as root
nvlink_measured.measured_instead: per-card PCIe throughput by phases (nvidia-smi dmon -s t): see nvlink-probe-phases.json
nvlink_measured.conclusion: the prompt path is on PCIe (62-78 GB rx, 7-12 GB tx per card during a 125K-token request, peaks 5-6 GB/s of the ~7.9 GB/s Gen3 x8 link); generation barely uses it; the engine's P2P prompt routes are not enabled in this config (STRATA_PREFILL_HELP unset, no --peer-experts, and prefill.cpp:1591 forces the mapped-host route)

interconnect_probe.phases: idle / generation / idle / prefill 32K / idle / prefill 128K / idle
interconnect_probe.note: run separately from the timed benchmark: the counters themselves perturb the GPU
